title: deadline.moved@1
description: An open ask's deadline moved later: by the time the hub was down or the Mac asleep before it had shown, or to its kind's minimum notice once it showed. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

span.description: How much later the deadline moved, in ms.

deadline.description: The ask's deadline from now on, in ms since the Unix epoch.

because.description: away: the hub was down or the Mac asleep while the ask hadn't shown; notice: it first showed with less than its kind's minimum notice left.

x-closure.closed: each value is a cause the asks core defines for moving a deadline, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema
